primary_title: The Protooncogene c-Maf Is an Essential Transcription Factor for IL-10 Gene Expression in Macrophages
decision_basis: Review-guided primary evidence identifies c-Maf binding to the IL10 promoter as an essential component of LPS-responsive IL-10 transcription in macrophages.
limitations_preserved: Direct promoter binding and c-Maf loss/ gain support IL10 gene transcription, but c-Maf is not sufficient alone and LPS/cofactor context is required; gene transcription only, with no automatic IL-10 protein secretion, receptor signaling, SCI or terminal-TF inference.

primary_title: Stat4 limits DNA methyltransferase recruitment and DNA methylation of the IL-18Ralpha gene during Th1 differentiation
decision_basis: Review-guided primary evidence identifies IL18R1 as a STAT4-bound, IL-12-responsive Th1 locus whose expression and chromatin state depend on STAT4-mediated promoter programming.
limitations_preserved: STAT4 promoter occupancy and STAT4-dependent expression/chromatin programming support gene-level IL18R1 transcription, but differentiation and epigenetic cofactor context are required; do not infer IL-18R protein abundance or signaling outside the measured Th1 system, SCI or terminal-TF effects.

primary_title: Proprotein convertase furin is preferentially expressed in T helper 1 cells and regulates interferon gamma
decision_basis: Review-guided primary evidence identifies FURIN as an IL-12/STAT4-regulated gene with inducible STAT4 promoter occupancy in Th1 cells.
limitations_preserved: IL-12-dependent STAT4 occupancy and Stat4-dependent FURIN induction support gene-level transcription, while the downstream secretion result is context-specific; preserve Th1/T-cell and promoter-region limits and do not infer broad FURIN processing, SCI or terminal-TF effects.

primary_title: Chromatin remodeling by the SWI/SNF-like BAF complex and STAT4 activation synergistically induce IL-12Rbeta2 expression during human Th1 cell differentiation
decision_basis: Review-guided primary evidence identifies STAT4 binding and STAT4 dependence at the IL12RB2 enhancer during human Th1 differentiation.
limitations_preserved: STAT4 enhancer occupancy and knockdown support IL12RB2 transcription in cooperation with TCR-induced BAF remodeling; preserve human Th1 differentiation and cofactor dependence and do not infer receptor signaling, SCI or terminal-TF effects automatically.

primary_title: Cutting edge: stage-specific requirement of IL-18 for antiviral NK cell expansion
decision_basis: Review-guided primary evidence identifies Myd88 as an IL-12/STAT4-responsive gene in activated NK cells through STAT4 promoter occupancy and Stat4-dependent expression.
limitations_preserved: STAT4 promoter occupancy and Stat4-dependent Myd88 expression are supported in activated NK cells, with downstream MyD88/IL-18 biology shown in the same infection model; preserve NK/MCMV context and do not infer universal STAT4 regulation, SCI or terminal-TF effects.
